Dex AI Assistant uses phone state, call-log access, and contacts to identify callers, announce callers, answer or decline calls you approve, and place calls for saved contacts. Dex uses text-message access for texts you approve and emergency trusted-contact texts when enabled. Dex uses microphone access for voice commands like "Hey Dex" and "answer," and notifications for reminders and background status. You can turn Dex features off later in Dex settings or Android system settings.
